audit.why: Maokai owns the level 2-3 window, Ornn owns everything from 6 onward — an even lane with a clean handover.
audit.corrected: diff kept; phase prose now names the cause on each side of the handover.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 read Ornn and row 4 read Skill.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill, Maokai, Maokai, Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, and mirror maokai__ornn already flipped rows 1, 2 to Maokai and row 4 to Ornn. The page's own whys[1] and whys[2] say Maokai out-trades and edges those levels, and whys[4] says Ornn wins the all-in.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 to Maokai, row 4 to Ornn, in matched full/content pairs; ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to 'dodge' Twisted Advance, never gives a cooldown, and never mentions the untargetability.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is 14s at rank 1 and Maokai is UNTARGETABLE for the whole dash, so R or E spent into it is spent for nothing — you wait it out rather than dodge it. Bramble Smash is 7s at 600 range and knocks back. Sapling Toss is 18s at 1100 range and stronger in brush. Nature's Grasp is 130s at 3000 range. Sap Magic's heal cooldown is reduced every time he casts a spell OR is struck by one, so chipping him with Bellows Breath actively accelerates his sustain.
audit.corrected: The untargetable rule, the Sap-Magic acceleration and the 7s / 14s / 18s / 130s numbers written into phases, do/don'ts, cooldowns and breakdown.mid.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Maokai's Twisted Advance is down.
edits.after: Bramble Smash is 7s and knocks you back; you have no shield yet. He wins level 2 outright — just farm it out.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Maokai must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Sap Magic heals faster every time a spell touches him, so your W chip refunds itself. He still edges level 3.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Maokai's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God's double knock-up beats him: Maokai is immobile once Twisted Advance's 14s is spent, and he cannot leave a 2500-range R.

edits.before: His lock-on root. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 14s at rank 1, and he is untargetable during the dash — wait it out.

edits.before: That is Maokai's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Never spend R or E into his W dash — he is untargetable for the whole of it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Sapling Toss is 18s and hits harder in brush — fight in the open.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Sap Magic's heal comes off cooldown faster every time a spell hits him — chip him and you speed it up.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance: matchup-defining — His lock-on root. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Maokai Twisted Advance: matchup-defining — 14s at rank 1, and he is untargetable through the dash. - Bramble Smash: 7s knockback. - Nature's Grasp: 130s, 3000 range, and the wall roots everything in its path.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Twisted Advance: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade after Twisted Advance's 14s is spent — before that he roots you through anything. Bring Grievous Wounds: Sap Magic refunds your chip.

notes: Left flagged rather than edited: whys[4], spikes[1] and mid all claim Bellows Breath 'stays unstoppable through his root'. Riot's W text says only that Ornn advances breathing fire and applies Brittle — no immunity — so that claim cannot be verified from the data, and it is load-bearing here because the level-6 all-in advice depends on it. Also unverified: the repeated 'sapling-empowered W root dash' phrasing in whys[1], early and wants.foe[0] — the kit gives no link between Sapling Toss and Twisted Advance.
